Q5002.reason: The evenhanded safety regulation is constitutional if its local safety benefits outweigh its incidental burden on interstate commerce.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest could vest more than 21 years after all lives in being and therefore violates the Rule Against Perpetuities, leaving the friend with absolute title.

Q5010.reason: Section 2 of the Thirteenth Amendment authorizes Congress to eliminate badges and incidents of slavery, including private racial discrimination in property transactions.
